scope: Current aggregation,statistical reporting,non-applicability of structural NAS to defined recipes,deliverables and guide appendices. Documentary joins and state reconciliation preserve all scientific artifacts.

aggregation.primary_estimand: Mean of individual-seed RMSE on the common chronology
aggregation.primary_null: baseline RMSE minus candidate RMSE <= delta

delivery.Top3_uncertainty_status: complete within literal empirical-coverage scope; adverse coverage and dependence limitations retained

interpretation: One market and correlated daily windows do not become multiple independent datasets or markets through six optimization seeds.
Primary RMSE effects, daily mean-square-loss contrasts, descriptive superiority fractions and bootstrap tail probabilities are different estimands.
Marginal difference intervals are not simultaneous merely because adjusted p-values are shown alongside them.
Mixed effects are a recommended model under a justified structure, not a universally mandatory substitute for every temporal test; current variance decomposition remains unreported.
Unavailable effect-size intervals and unexecuted controls stay explicit; no values are invented to fill Appendix A3.
The current defined recipes do not trigger NAS1000/two-stage requirements. Their source provenance, adaptations and training HPO retain their own obligations.
Completing an evidence checklist means reporting scoped states; it does not mean all requirements passed or imply a numerical grade.
Original evaluation weights remain 15/15/25/20/15/10; NAS non-applicability does not redistribute the implementation-and-rigor criterion.
The previous five synthetic data guards retain their original post-benchmark receipt; this update does not rerun them.
The delivery auditor verifies published files and A2 arithmetic without retraining or regenerating all scientific products.

evidence_sources.scope: Twenty primary contrast rows with 41 fields copied/joined from existing refinement and original seed diagnostics.
A3 source hashes, joining rule, field scopes and explicit absence of primary standardized-effect confidence intervals.
Twenty-one literal guide items: nine complete within scope, ten partial, two NAS items not applicable. No grade derived.
Current B-item states, evidence, scope and remaining limitations; previous versions preserved.
Twelve literal deliverables and six original weights totalling 100%; no redistribution or assigned grade.
